product_family: Avalara tax compliance and agentic AI platform: AvaTax (tax calculation), Avalara Returns / Managed Returns / Returns for Accountants, Exemption Certificate Management (ECM), e-invoicing and Property Tax modules, plus new Avi/agentic AI compliance agents ("ALFA" AI foundry).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Avalara AvaTax, Avalara Managed Returns, Avalara Returns for Accountants, Avalara Managed Returns for Accountants, and Avalara Exemption Certificate Management solutions have successfully completed the Service Organization Control (SOC) 2 Type 2 examination.

certifications.name: SOC 1 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Avalara's own Knowledge Center references an 'SSAE 18 SOC 1 Type 2 report' available on customer request (help.avalara.com FAQ 'How can I request a copy of Avalara's SSAE 18 SOC 1 Type 2 report').

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: With role-based access and certifications, including SOC 2 and ISO 27001, Avalara is ready for the most demanding compliance environments.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 / ISO 27018
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on any avalara.com or newsroom.avalara.com page. Third-party aggregator sites (e.g. a finance-tools review blog) list these alongside SOC 1/2 and ISO 27001, but the claim could not be traced to a vendor-domain source.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. A third-party security-scoring site (nudgesecurity.com) lists Avalara as 'HIPAA Compliant, PCI Compliant, FedRamp Compliant, CSA Star Level 1 Compliant' but this is not a vendor-domain source, is not corroborated anywhere on avalara.com, legal.avalara.com, or newsroom.avalara.com, and looks like an automated badge inference rather than a verified claim. Avalara is a tax-compliance platform, not a healthcare data processor, so HIPAA is likely out of scope.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: We use third-party payment provider CyberSource and Fiserv, to process payments made to us... We do not retain any personally identifiable financial information, such as payment card number, you provide these third-party payment providers in connection with payments.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on any avalara.com page or in Avalara newsroom releases. Only a third-party (non-vendor) site makes this claim, unverified.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on any avalara.com page. Only an unverified third-party claim exists.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 42001 or an equivalent AI-governance certification despite Avalara's heavy marketing push around agentic AI (ALFA, Avi).

certifications.name: GDPR (posture, not a certification)
certifications.proof_quote: Avalara, Inc. Services Data Processing Agreement ... EEA & United Kingdom Privacy Notice ... Subprocessors ... This Privacy Notice describes our privacy practices where we are acting as the controller of personal data.

privacy.ai_training_note: No vendor-domain page found that states whether customer transaction/tax data is used to train Avalara's AI models (ALFA foundry, Avi agents) or how to opt out. Avalara's Services Data Processing Agreement states Avalara processes Customer Data only per customer instructions and 'shall not process Customer Data for any other purpose,' which would argue against training on customer data, but no explicit AI-training statement or opt-out mechanism was located.
privacy.data_region: Multiple regional privacy notices found (US, EEA/UK, Australia, India, Brazil), indicating global data handling with region-specific entities (Avalara, Inc. and Avalara Europe Ltd. each have their own DPA). No single consolidated data-residency statement found on a vendor page.

security.name: Access control
security.value: Role-based access controls and audit trails referenced on the AI-compliance product page.

security.name: Uptime / availability
security.value: '99.99% uptime with multicloud, active-active redundancy' claimed on the homepage; no independent status-page evidence reviewed.

security.name: Payment data handling
security.value: Avalara does not retain payment card data itself; card payments are processed by third parties CyberSource and Fiserv.

security.name: TLS / API certificates
security.value: Developer documentation references TLS/SSL certificates used for the AvaTax REST API in both sandbox and production environments.

products.name: AvaTax
products.data_scope: Transaction-level tax data, product/SKU data, exemption info
products.notes: Named directly in the 2023 SOC 2 Type 2 scope.

products.name: Avalara Managed Returns / Returns for Accountants
products.data_scope: Filed return data, business tax IDs, jurisdiction data
products.notes: Named directly in the 2023 SOC 2 Type 2 scope.

products.name: Exemption Certificate Management (ECM)
products.data_scope: Customer exemption certificates, buyer identity data
products.notes: Named directly in the 2023 SOC 2 Type 2 scope.

products.name: Avi / agentic AI compliance agents (ALFA foundry)
products.category: AI agents embedded in ERPs/billing platforms
products.data_scope: Transaction and compliance data from connected business systems, aggregated across 60,000+ regulatory sources
products.notes: Newest product line (launched 2025); no dedicated SOC 2/ISO scope statement found for this line specifically, only a general company-level 'SOC 2 and ISO 27001' claim on its own marketing page.

products.name: E-Invoicing / Live Reporting
products.data_scope: Invoice-level transaction data for regulatory submission
products.notes: Third-party research indicates a related Avalara-owned entity (formerly Impendulo, now part of Avalara Europe) held an ISO 27001 certificate for this scope; this certification is not attributed to the parent Avalara brand.

compare.pricing_model: Quote-based / tiered by transaction volume and modules (not publicly listed pricing)
compare.data_residency: Multi-region (US and EEA/UK legal entities with separate DPAs; also has India, Australia, Brazil privacy notices)

flags: SOC 2 Type 2 proof is scoped to five named products (AvaTax, Managed Returns, Returns for Accountants, Managed Returns for Accountants, ECM) as of January 2023, not a blanket company-wide certification, and no more recent renewal announcement was found.

ISO 27001 claim only appears as unscoped marketing copy on the ai-compliance.html product page ('certifications, including SOC 2 and ISO 27001'), with no cert number, issuing body, scope, or date found on any vendor page, weaker evidence than the SOC 2 press release.

Third-party security-scoring sites (not vendor-owned) claim Avalara also holds HIPAA, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, and CSA STAR certifications; none of these could be corroborated on any avalara.com, legal.avalara.com, or newsroom.avalara.com page.

No public statement found on whether customer/transaction data is used to train Avalara's AI agents (Avi, ALFA) or how to opt out, a notable gap given the company's heavy 2025-2026 push into agentic AI.

A separate ISO 27001 certificate is reportedly held by 'Impendulo by Avalara' (an acquired French e-invoicing subsidiary); this is excluded from the parent-brand cert list since it is a subsidiary's product-specific certification, not company-wide coverage.
